It takes up the task to set up mobile medical centres in the affected location, distributing hygiene kits, spreading health information, training local health workers and has also supported the country during floods, rehabilitation during epidemics, earthquakes and communal violence situations. Skill Development & Livelihood Programme It conducts six-month certificate courses in health assistant training and a four-month dental assistant training for young girls from underprivileged backgrounds. The courses are customized to cater to girls with minimum qualifications and delivered in Hindi to enable easy learning and secure gainful employment. Its rural initiative focuses on providing accessible healthcare to rural masses enabling primary, secondary and tertiary levels of care. It works in slums and poor settlements to address the nutrition requirements of newborns and young children through screening and counselling sessions with follow-ups and relevant treatment. DFY functions on humanitarian principles of humanity, impartiality, and neutrality. It offers services and assistance to people based on need, irrespective of race, class, caste, religion and gender. The following are vision, mission and guiding principles of Doctors For You (DFY). we believe in bridging the healthcare gap to provide health for all by strengthening the government healthcare infrastructure. Sustainable change is facilitated by the above, with a clear mandate to not create parallel systems but rather create, support and facilitate efficiencies and best practices that eliminate health care disparities and increase access --> Milestones & Track Record DFY MILESTONES ACHIEVED IN 2021-2022 1) Maternal & Child Health Care- 1400+ Pregnant Womens 2) Tuberculosis Patients Notified- 34,000+ TB Patients 3) Cancer patients supported with Patient Navigation Services- 38,000+ Cancer Patients 4) Disaster Management -COVID-19 Patients Treatment- 80,000+ COVID-19 Patients 5) MMU Community Outreached- 100000+Patients 6) Strengthened Capacity of Hospitals- 500+ Hospitals 7) Farmland saved from Crop Burning- 161,000+ acres of ag. land 8) Skill Development of Nursing Assistants, Dental Assistant and Hygiene technicians-2000+ Hygiene Technicians Doctors for You listed among Top 50 NGO’s, by World Economic Forum, 2021 Best International Organization Ketto Award (2021) CSR BOX Award 2021 for Covid Relief Response Work, 202 --> Donor Testimonial I am associated with DOCTORS FOR YOU since July 2020, where UNICEF collaborated with DFY for Strengthening Risk Communication and Community Engagement (RCCE), COVID19 surveillance, contact tracing, IPC and ensuring continuity of essential RMNCA health and nutrition services during COVID19 emergency in two wards of Mumbai. The partnership with DFY proved extremely strategic for reaching out to the most marginalized and vulnerable section of the urban slums the expertise and experience of DFY team in emergency work is remarkable. Based on this experience UNICEF continued the partnership with DFY towards a long term goal of Health Systems strengthening through comprehensive Urban Primary Health Care approach in MCGM. DFY has extremely good connect with the communities and therefore engaging through DFY gives immense advantage working with vulnerable and marginalized communities. I would definitely prefer working with DFY in future. - Dr. Mangesh Gadhari, Health Officer, UNICEF COVID-19 has been taking a toll on people all around the world since 2020, and the situation in India was no different. Crypto relief opted to work with DFY to support emergency healthcare responses during these critical times. Our collaboration with DFY has been pivotal in providing healthcare services and reaching out to marginalised communities through various Covid-19 focussed programmes. Doctors for you and our organisation has been associated with each other since the beginning of 2021 and have collaborated for various projects focussing on addressing the rural health needs. The district pandemic response and rural outreach program for addressing health needs of the people living in the rural and tribal areas has been key highlights of our collaborative work this year. As part of the third wave of Covid-19 support, Doctors For You (DFY) has created 5 Covid hospitals across India as part of the Crypto Relief project. The hospitals have a combined capacity of 1000 beds, including 70 intensive care units and 130 paediatric beds. The centres are being developed in partnership with the local government and the state health departments across Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Maharashtra and Karnataka. We have also worked together in distribution of ration kits and setting up of a command centre for COVID-19 affected people. Our organisation extends appreciation to Doctors For You for their continuous effort and strong work ethics. We take immense pride in this association formed on the foundation of transparency and accountability which are our core values.- Mr. Sandeep Nailwal, Crypto relief Our relationship with Doctors For You during peak of the second wave of the Covid pandemic resulted in an extremely meaningful and gratifying collaboration between a group of corporate donars who donated ICU equipment to Government Hospitals in Bangalore. DFY provided the much needed manpower and operational expertise required to set up and operationalise ICU in the most challenging times . We are grateful for their commitment & support, and look forward to combining our efforts in the future to build a safer, healthier society-Ms. Shaina Ganapathy Assistant Vice President ‑ Community Outreach, Embassy Property Developments Private Limited Shapoorji Pallonji has been associated with DFY on a nutrition enhancement programme in 2016-19 and we were very impressed with the commitment of the field teams in ensuring the project is undertaken and monitored well. Their Health Assistants who are young girls from the community were specifically trained to educate, create awareness and monitor the program reach. DFY also was quick to pivot the model based on ground realities and needs (moving to community-based working from a center based model)”- Zarine Commissariat, Shapoorji Pallonji Since last year, COVID-19 has been continuously affecting lives across the globe and the situation was not much different in India as well. It was during the first wave of COVID- 19 pandemic, Wipro foundation decided to partner with DFY to support the emergency healthcare responses. Our partnership with DFY has been instrumental in providing critical healthcare-by setting up isolation and treatment centers, providing ambulance support for transportation of COVID patients, and reaching out to the marginalized communities through effective COVID screening programmes, especially in hard-hit locations like Mumbai and Delhi both during the first and second wave of COVID. DFY was proactive and committed in this emergency and was well equipped in delivering timely healthcare services, which was the need of the hour. We appreciate the way DFY as an organization has adapted towards a system that not only involves immediate handling of disaster response but their expertise and knowledge in the domain that make them capable of foreseeing, planning, and preparing for the worst-case scenarios. If the opportunity presents itself in the future, we would be happy to work with DFY- Dr. Parvathy Mohandas, Wipro Foundation Ketto.org is South East Asia's most visited and trusted crowdfunding platform. Co-founded by Varun Sheth, Zaheer Adenwala and Actor Kunal Kapoor with an aim to bridge the affordability gap. Here at Ketto, we enable people to raise funds for health and medical emergencies, natural calamities, education, short-term emergency needs, animal welfare, women empowerment, and many more. Over the course of the pandemic, Ketto hosted around 12,500 campaigns and raised over Rs 300 cores for COVID relief fundraisers. Doctors For You (DFY) collaborated with us during this time and successfully raised funds to assist the country during the COVID crises, especially when the 2nd wave infested the nation and its resources. DFY assisted in the provision of oxygen, medical equipment, and other necessities. They even teamed up with celebrities, public figures, and others to make a bigger impact. DFY's vision to provide affordable & quality medical relief, sustainable & robust healthcare services, capacity building & risk reduction activities in crisis or otherwise; aligns with Ketto's mission to connect people to healthcare and happiness. It was very convenient to be able to work with a foundation that reflects and follows similar guidelines to Ketto and its future plans, and it also gave us a boost to keep doing what we're doing. When our country was hit by the second wave of COVID, health workers from Doctors For You (DFY) put their lives on the line to help struggling hospitals and critical patients across the country. Led by COVID War Time Consigliere - Saket Kumar SonuWa, numerous fundraisers on Ketto contributed to DFY's COVID relief efforts across the country. The following campaigns are just a few examples of how impactful DFY's campaigns on Ketto had on the nation- Actor & Co- Founder Kunal Kapoor, Ketto --> --> Leadership Team Dr. Taru Sneh Jindal Doctor at Doctors for You Dr. Ravikant Singh Founder Dr. Rajat Jain President Saket Jha Secretary Dr. Nidhi Singh Jt. Over the past 14 years, DFY has established itself as an organization with technical capacity to respond to different types of humanitarian crisis. The organization has been working in the field of general healthcare services, public health , emergency response and rehabilitation projects, training and capacity building programme and research studies The organization has been recognized for its humanitarian work in India and outside. The combined effort of the doctors from different parts of world, paramedics, volunteers and our employees has brought many laurels to the organisation. Over the course of the pandemic, Ketto hosted around 12,500 campaigns and raised over Rs 300 cores for COVID relief fundraisers. Doctors For You (DFY) collaborated with us during this time and successfully raised funds to assist the country during the COVID crises, especially when the 2nd wave infested the nation and its resources. DFY assisted in the provision of oxygen, medical equipment, and other necessities. They even teamed up with celebrities, public figures, and others to make a bigger impact. DFY's vision to provide affordable & quality medical relief, sustainable & robust healthcare services, capacity building & risk reduction activities in crisis or otherwise; aligns with Ketto's mission to connect people to healthcare and happiness. It was very convenient to be able to work with a foundation that reflects and follows similar guidelines to Ketto and its future plans, and it also gave us a boost to keep doing what we're doing. When our country was hit by the second wave of COVID, health workers from Doctors For You (DFY) put their lives on the line to help struggling hospitals and critical patients across the country. Led by COVID War Time Consigliere - Saket Kumar SonuWa, numerous fundraisers on Ketto contributed to DFY's COVID relief efforts across the country.
